questions.question_en: Did Jesus ride into Jerusalem on a donkey?
Did the crowd wave palm branches and shout Hosanna?
questions.question_ko: 사람들은 종려나무 가지를 흔들며 호산나를 외쳤나요?

questions.question_en: Was the crowd angry and silent when Jesus arrived?
questions.question_ko: 예수님이 도착했을 때 사람들은 화가 나서 조용했나요?
questions.feedback_en: No, the crowd was joyful and shouted praises!
